description: Project knowledge base for Sales Chatbot & WHMCS Integration Platform

entities.name: WHMCS API
observations: Primary billing and client management system
Response format: JSON with result field (success/error)
AddOrder API does NOT support service renewals - use genInvoices() instead
Phone number search requires exact normalized format (e.g., 923001234567)
Invoice generation is async, may take 5-10 seconds
Ticket attachments must be base64 encoded
Rate limit: ~100 requests per minute per IP

entities.name: WHM API
observations: Requires root username for API calls
API keys configured per server: WHM_API_KEY_<SERVER_NAME>
SSL verification should be enabled in production
Rate limits apply - implement exponential backoff
Cache server lists (TTL: 30 minutes, force refresh: 24 hours)

entities.name: MongoDB Database
observations: TTL indexes for auto-cleanup (chats, notifications: 24 hours)
Requires IP whitelist in Atlas for connections
Use lean() queries for better performance
Indexes required: createdAt, phone, userId fields

entities.name: Phone Number Normalization
observations: Always normalize phone numbers before WHMCS search
Format: country code + number without spaces/symbols

entities.name: WebSocket Configuration
observations: CORS must match frontend origin exactly
Support both websocket and polling transports
On cPanel shared hosting, requires .htaccess proxy config
Always cleanup listeners in React useEffect return

entities.name: cPanel Credential Resolution
observations: Credentials stored in WHMCS product custom fields
Returns: host, username, password, port, secure
Fallback: check client products and domains
Never log passwords or API tokens

entities.name: Production Deployment
observations: Process manager: PM2 or cPanel Node.js app

entities.name: WordPress Diagnostic Flow
observations: Steps: connection, filesystem, database, config, plugins, permissions, logs
Each step returns structured result with success/message/details
Uses cPanel API for file and database operations
Logs all actions for audit trail
Provides rollback mechanism for critical changes

entities.name: Chat Notification System
observations: Cleanup job runs hourly via Agenda

relations.notes: Client search requires normalized phone numbers
Server credentials used for cPanel operations
Requires cPanel credentials to perform diagnostics
Server list cached in MongoDB for performance

knownIssues.description: AddOrder API cannot renew existing services
knownIssues.workaround: Check for existing unpaid invoices first, or wait for automatic invoice generation

knownIssues.description: WebSocket connections may fail without proper proxy configuration
Auto-sync on startup can cause memory issues
knownIssues.workaround: Set AUTO_SYNC_ON_STARTUP=false and run sync via cron

bestPractices: Always normalize phone numbers before WHMCS API calls
Use lean() queries for MongoDB read operations
Always cleanup WebSocket listeners in React
Use thin controllers, thick services pattern
Handle errors gracefully with user-friendly messages
securityNotes: Enable SSL verification for WHM API in production
